entry.title: Dick’s Sporting Goods signs Caitlin Clark
entry.summary: The exclusive deal includes both Dick’s and Foot Locker, and is the first time either company has signed an athlete as a brand partner.

entry.title: Consumers face higher grocery prices
entry.summary: Grocery inflation rose in October, as fuel price increases pushed up the costs of many foods.

entry.title: Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger owner to cut 4% of workforce
entry.summary: PVH Corp.'s enterprisewide initiative aims to improve productivity and long-term profitability, with a goal of achieving $100 million in cost savings during fiscal 2027.

entry.title: TikTok Shop pilots paid membership
entry.summary: The company recently rolled out a paid tier to 1 million shoppers. With membership, consumers get free shipping and exclusive discounts.

entry.title: Walmart more than doubles planned drone delivery sites
entry.summary: An expansion with drone operator Zipline will allow the retailer to make rapid air delivery available to customers nationwide over the next several years.

entry.title: Michaels encourages a screen-free holiday season
entry.summary: The retailer is promoting hands-on creativity with its “Countdown to Craftsmas” Advent calendar, alongside early Black Friday deals.

entry.title: BNPL bolsters holiday budgets
entry.summary: Younger shoppers favor buy now, pay later more than older generations, but BNPL companies draw consumers across income brackets, a survey finds.

entry.title: Sally Beauty to expand refreshed store model in 2027
entry.summary: The beauty supply retailer will grow the Sally Ignited store concept and has long-term plans to refresh two-thirds of its overall store fleet.

entry.title: The Weekly Closeout: Target names a new board member and Centric Brands sells itself to CEO
entry.summary: The big-box retailer appointed Sally Grimes as an independent director. Meanwhile, Jason Rabin took ownership of the conglomerate.

entry.title: Family Dollar will pay $63M to settle unfair-pricing claims from state, federal regulators
entry.summary: The discounter said it’s cooperating and “focused on strengthening pricing accuracy across our stores and maintaining our customers' trust.”
